title: Dbomb's Textures
description: This project adds pvp textures that i personally enjoy and made, i did have some inspiration from some packs i used so i thought i'd make my own so that way i dont have 8 different texture packs active
body: I made this pack becaues i wanted my own pack with my own likes and such, it has different sounds, particles, all that for pvp wise. It also has side shield and low fire, all that jazz.I tried to make it as optimal as i could for pvp gameplay but also for regular gameplay, you might not like the sounds but i do, i made it for me, but im sharing it to all of you.
